page.overview:
Who is Reina Bilass?

Reina Bilass, formerly known as Reina Ganzee, was a humanoid female Jedi Initiate during the High Republic Era. Born in the Coruscant Underworld's level eleven-eighty, she was found at a young age by the Ganzee Gang, a notorious criminal group which used young children as agents, and raised on level ten-fourteen. When Reina was found to be Force-sensitive, the gang willingly handed her over to the Jedi Order, hoping that she would one day return the favor. However, the girl resisted, changing her surname to "Bilass" and reacting negatively to any perceived incursion by the gang into the Temple District. Despite only being an initiate, she became a mentor to Lohim Nara, who could not become a Jedi Knight but could study to become a guardian of the Temple.
